channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: How are visually impaired cyclists classified for competition? We spoke to the professor in charge at British Blind Sport to find out
item.description: Professor Joy Myint – head classifier with British Blind Sport (BBS) – talks us through her role classifying the UK’s blind and visually impaired athletes

item.title: Wilier Filante SLR ID2 SRAM Red AXS
item.description: Fast aero race bike that delivers pro-level performance at a premium price 8/10

item.title: The unconventional classic that's hardly changed since the 1940s: an ode to the Paris Galibier
item.description: Most bike brands' long-standing flagship models go through revamp after revamp, so much so that the modern versions are almost unrecognisable from the originals - in the case of the Paris Galibier, first introduced in 1947, that certainly hasn't happened

item.title: Tour Down Under sticky bottle controversy blows up... but fans joke: "If that's the most egregious cheating in pro cycling you've seen, the sport's in a great place"; Telegraph in meltdown over "Stalinist" 15-minute cities + more on the live blog
item.description: Welcome back to another week of live blog action, Dan Alexander in the hot seat for your Monday round-up of all the goings on in the world of cycling today

item.title: Prungo FluxGo
item.description: Well-designed, easy-to-use recovery device that's genuinely convenient, but the price will limit its appeal. 7/10

item.title: “How will we be able to take the coffin out?” Vicar slams “underhanded” cycle lane plans that could ‘block access’ to church for hearses
item.description: “All I’m trying to do is just make sure people can get to church,” the vicar of St Mark’s Church in north London said in response to plans to introduce a new “safe, easy, and continuous” cycleway between Islington and Primrose Hill

item.title: Has Challenge created an all-round road tyre that "other tyres can't match"? Plus more from Scope, Vittoria, Oquo + Fulcrum
item.description: Five wheel and tyre upgrades from aero race wheels to gravel tyres for mud, here are the previews with full reviews coming soon

item.title: British Cycling CEO Jon Dutton to step down in summer to take Olympic role
item.description: “It has been a tremendous honour to lead British Cycling through such an important and ambitious period of change,” Dutton, whose time in charge of the governing body saw membership numbers drop by over 20,000, said

item.title: ‘Over-reaction based on vibes’: Are mandatory helmet and hi-vis laws for cyclists set to be introduced in Ireland?
item.description: The Irish government appears to be considering whether to make cycling without a helmet or reflective clothing a criminal offence, but campaigners say the “performative policymaking… shifts responsibility away from the most dangerous vehicles”

item.title: Near Miss of the Day 945: Fuming driver accused of harassing cyclists after deliberately veering towards group ride in “closest attack I’ve ever witnessed”
item.description: “The distance is less than a foot and would have brought down half the group at least”
